title: Meta Muse Connectors & Tasks: Soul.md Approval Rules
description: Configure Meta Muse Connectors, scheduled Tasks, and external tool confirmation gates inside Soul.md without cluttering Identity.md or Memory.md.
h1: Meta Muse Connectors & Tasks: writing clean approval rules in Soul.md.
dek: Once Muse has access to mail, calendar, or scheduled recurring Tasks, your Soul.md needs explicit read-vs-write confirmation gates.
lede: Most Soul.md templates only cover chat tone. Once you connect Meta Muse Connectors (mail, calendar, messaging, or docs) or set up recurring background Tasks, vague instructions like “be proactive” can trigger unwanted actions. Put explicit read-vs-write confirmation rules inside Soul.md while keeping identity in Identity.md and facts in Memory.md.
answer: In Meta Muse, keep tone, honesty rules, and Connector confirmation gates in Soul.md; keep name, role, and avatar in Identity.md; and keep personal facts and timezones in Memory.md. Require explicit approval before Muse sends external messages, edits shared calendar events, or deletes items during scheduled Tasks.

sections.h2: Which file governs Connectors, Tasks, and persona?
sections.html:
Muse surface / fileWhat belongs hereWhat happens when misplaced
Soul.md (Personality & Behavior)Voice rules, truthfulness gates, tool confirmation boundaries, draft-before-send defaultsPutting schedule facts here causes drift; omitting approval rules leaves side effects vague (Soul.md templates →)
Identity.md (Avatar & Card)Name, avatar vibe, one-line role description, surface greeting (setup guide →)Stuffing procedural approval matrices here crowds identity card limits
Memory.md (Facts & Context)Working hours, preferred recipients, formatting constants, standing context (privacy guide →)Storing behavioral prohibitions as memories makes them fragile when you prune memory entries
Scheduled Tasks / ConnectorsRecurrence timing, permitted external integrations, per-task prompt scopeAsking a Task to “handle my inbox” without dry-run limits leads to premature sends

sections.h2: Copy-paste Soul.md autonomy & Connector approval block.
sections.html:
Merge this block into your existing Soul.md using the Muse Soul.md Editor (it wraps your rules in reversible markers and lets you download a backup first):

## Connectors & Scheduled Tasks - Treat reading calendars, messages, and notes as read-only synthesis unless I explicitly approve an external action. - Always prepare a clickable summary, diff, or exact message draft first before creating events, replying to people, sending invites, or modifying external records. - When running a scheduled recurring Task: report verified inputs, state any failed Connector lookup explicitly, and stop at a reviewable shortlist rather than taking irreversible side effects silently. - Never fabricate missing Connector outputs or invent calendar slots when a tool call returns empty or errors out.

sections.h2: Practical read / draft / execute boundaries for everyday workflows.
sections.html:
WorkflowSafe automatic stepRequire confirmation gate
Morning brief (Scheduled Task)Aggregate upcoming events, deadlines, and unread highlights with exact timestampsDeclining invitations, rescheduling meetings, or messaging attendees
Email / message triageCluster threads by urgency and write editable reply draftsHitting send on any external thread or forwarding sensitive attachments
Research & side chatsFork long tangents into Muse Side Chats while keeping the main log clean (troubleshooting guide →)Overwriting permanent workspace docs or appending unverified claims to shared notes

faq.q: Should Connector approval rules go in Soul.md or Memory.md?
faq.a: Put durable confirmation gates and draft-first defaults in Soul.md because Soul.md governs behavior across conversations and Tasks. Keep mutable context (like your work hours or VIP contacts) in Memory.md.

faq.q: Can Soul.md overwrite existing customizations if I paste an approval block directly?
faq.a: Replacing all of Soul.md manually will erase existing persona traits unless you merge carefully. Use our Muse Soul.md Editor to preview the merge inside labeled markers and save an original backup first.

faq.q: How should a Meta Muse scheduled Task report failed lookups?
faq.a: Add an explicit rule telling Muse to quote tool failures verbatim and leave missing slots blank instead of inferring or smoothing over skipped Connector reads.

faq.q: Where do I inspect or pause saved facts Muse learned from Connectors?
faq.a: Inspect and trim Memory.md regularly under Assistant Identity / Memory settings, or audit an export locally with the AgentTune AI Memory Export Reviewer.
